payload.claim: `_CELL_DOWN_ORDER` hardcodes `"removed:network:saffron-critic-net"` as a literal instead of importing the constant `saffron.cell.session.CRITIC_NETWORK` that already names that exact value and that `tests/test_review_cells.py` (e.g. lines 170, 216, 257) imports and reuses rather than restating. This is the case the repo's 'import a name from the module that defines it' / one-source convention is meant to prevent: a second spelling of a value core already defines, which can drift silently from the real network name while this test keeps passing against its own copy.
